summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a breakthrough development of an orally dispersible film (ODF) formulation of its SCD1 inhibitor Aramchol for Parkinson's disease, targeting a $6 billion market. The press release reports preclinical data showing ~150% higher systemic bioavailability and ~300% increase in CNS exposure versus conventional oral administration, and highlights improved patient convenience for dysphagia. No specific financial terms, transaction, or special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, restructuring, tender offer) is described. This is a routine update on product development progress, not a special situation.
